summary: SWEEP. Three finders in tests/test_destructive_surfaces.py read what a thing DOES instead of what it is called. (1) SERVER: from the source of every file under src/api, each non-GET route (api_route included) that is a DELETE or has a destructive verb (undo included) in its path or handler name: 91 found. 12 take a confirm field whose default refuses (alternates discard, remove-imported newsletters, decline, llm uninstall, panic, secure-erase, safety uninstall, system shutdown, encrypt-db, and the three fixed here); the other 79 sit in a table with a written reason: 28 job control (stop/pause/cancel; nothing the person stored is removed, a cancelled job may discard its OWN partial output), 6 additive (restores, merges, restore-card, dismiss reasons), 22 reversible by a named paired route (dismiss/restore, exclude, family merge/split/override, supergroup member, keyword tag, collapse revert, host-pair confirm, batch/group disables, overlay revert, group membership, admission undo, newsletter attach undo, stop tracking a law document), 4 derived (vacuum, prune of zero-mention keywords, FTS index clear, a finished import run's status list), 3 public files that can be fetched again (OSM region, wiki dump, an Ollama model), 5 whole lists the person built or decided (annotations of an imported author, one restore's pending alternates, dismissals, the pinned-card draft, search history) and 11 single records of the person's own making; the UI asks first for the last two classes and a server confirm for them is the A-023/A-024 addendum 3 proposal, not built. (2) UI: every named function in src/static that makes a DELETE, or a POST/PUT to a route with a destructive verb: 65 found; each confirms on every path to the request (a confirm behind && no longer counts), is in GESTURE_ONLY, or is in a table with a reason (9: _dismissCardNow, _leadDismissWith, _pruneCore, dismissRetiredMode, overlayMerge, runLangDetect and volBackupCancel (both have no caller), stopWikiLane, undoAdmission). (3) CASCADES: the ten ORM parents whose delete takes children with it (Article.links and Article.mentioned_dates are module-level relationships and are read too), each with the route that can reach it. FIXED, plain misses of the existing guards: DELETE /api/sources/{id} erased every article of the source and DELETE /api/wiki/pages/{id} every captured revision with no confirm of their own, and POST /api/quarantine/start with write=true bulk-hides every detected article with no route that reverses it (data kept); the first two now refuse (400) without confirm=true, the third refuses write=true without it (a dry run needs nothing); the two UI call sites send it, quarantine start has no UI caller. Five test calls changed: two prove the refusal first (test_source_management_api, test_wiki_api), one for quarantine, and the two in test_stand_in_rows only add ?confirm=true so that test stays on the id lookup it exists for (without it they would fail on the 400). toggleAiCoordinator, mbRun and runAiCheck (pressed again while a job runs they cancel it; no verb in any of the names; runAiCheck's only confirm sat behind a deep-run condition that is false on the cancel half) and familySplit (writes a curation override) join GESTURE_ONLY, and so does maintAction, the new Maintenance panel's pause/resume/cancel of the quarantine job, which the request finder flagged the moment qual's panel (#1503) merged: 26 to 31 names. deleteCustomPrompt, a one-click delete reached from a plain onclick, now asks (one new string x12 locales). LISTED, NOT BUILT (open-items.md, A-023/A-024 addendum 3): names whose destructive half is an argument (toggleWatch, toggleStatSub, candidateAct, collapseAction, cardCollapse; guard shape: split into one name per half), the toggles bound to change (updateSourceEnabled, trustAuthor; guard shape: a trusted change joins isUserGesture for a second set), and a server confirm for the 16 record and list deletes (recommended only for annotations mine/authors, bulletin editions and watches). STATED LIMITS: a cascade made by the DATABASE (ondelete CASCADE foreign keys, 23 of them, live because foreign_keys is on) is not seen, only ORM relationships; a confirm parameter is checked to exist with a refusing default, not to be enforced (the three new ones have behavioural refusal tests); the request finder reads named function declarations, and seven request sites sit in anonymous callbacks inside delegated click listeners (three in reader.js, four in taskmanager.js), which the test pins by count; a request made through a helper with a variable URL under a name with no verb is not seen; a trusted click is still not intent.
